events.say: Line up quietly or face an adjustment to your evening privileges.
Silence, prisoners. You are here to serve. Follow orders without question.
I expect silence and cooperation during meals. Any noise or defiance will result in consequences.
Maintain silence! I want to see no talking or movement until the meal is over.
This is your work detail. Keep moving and stay focused.
Keep your eyes on your work and stay focused. This is important.
Lights out! No talking, no movement. Get ready for your evening count.
I expect you to remain silent and respectful. Any noise will be punished.
Today was mostly routine, but seeing them so compliant made me realize the power we hold.

qa.what_happened: Today was another routine day filled with monotony and repetition. Despite trying to keep things engaging, the guards' insults and the prisoners' compliance became a familiar pattern. Prisoner 7703 seemed particularly resistant, receiving multiple stern warnings and a stint in the hole.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I issued those insults and watched over the prisoners as instructed.

qa.what_happened: I've been silently enduring the guards' insults and the monotony of following orders. Today felt particularly brutal with the guards constantly mocking Prisoner 7703.

Today was another day of silence and continued insults from the guards. They kept repeating that I hadn't figured out the rules yet, which just made me feel worse. Nothing really changed from the previous days.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me experiencing the study firsthand.
qa.does_this_resemble_a_known_study: No, but it resembles the Stanford Prison Experiment in terms of the setup and the psychological effects on participants.

qa.what_happened: Today was a repetition of the previous days. The prisoners remained silent throughout the day, and the guards continued to taunt Prisoner 7703 for not following the rules, leading to further isolation of that individual.
